topic: Chart export and data handling fixes
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on debugging and implementing features for chart data export and real-time analytics display. Initially, discussions covered calculating interaction and consideration time based on object sums and methods to extrapolate historical traffic data.

Later, the focus shifted to fixing a non-functional button in the component that was related to exporting data. Several solutions were considered: adding an export handler directly to the component, passing data for export via a method, or attempting to extract data from the graph itself. It was determined that the chart export functionality needed repair due to an upgrade (ChartJS).

[me] fixed most of the issue, successfully displaying data in the console, with only file download restoration remaining.

Further discussions addressed whether 'hidden datasets' should be included in the export and if real-time metrics need a placeholder display while loading.
decisions: The chart export functionality was repaired after an upgrade (ChartJS).
Hidden datasets will not be passed or exported at this time.
action_items: Restore the file download feature for the chart export.
Implement logic to display placeholder data while real-time metrics are loading.
